mapper.select: select ur.role_id as id, count(distinct u.user_id) as members from sys_user_role ur join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and (u.user_type = '00' or u.user_type is null or u.user_type = '') group by ur.role_id
select e.dept_id as id, count(*) as members from nad_employee e where e.dept_id is not null and e.employment_status <> 'TERMINATED' group by e.dept_id
select e.position_id as id, count(*) as members from nad_employee e where e.position_id is not null and e.employment_status <> 'TERMINATED' group by e.position_id
